instruction: Can you switch the search engine to Yahoo for my web searches?

metadata.explanation: Variation 2: Change default search engine to Yahoo. Uses existing get_default_search_engine getter and match_in_list metric. Evaluator accepts both 'Yahoo' and 'Yahoo!' as valid names.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts default search engine from Chrome Preferences file (chrome.py:200-231)
Metric correctly checks if result matches one of the expected values using match_in_list (general.py:50-57)
Expected values are semantically correct - accepts both 'Yahoo' and 'Yahoo!' variants
Postconfig appropriately kills and restarts Chrome with sleep to ensure Preferences file is flushed to disk
Complete coverage - evaluator verifies the exact requirement in the instruction (switching search engine to Yahoo)
No edge case issues - getter has proper error handling and defaults to 'Google' on failure
